source_status: Accepted historical candidate; strictly read-only; implementation facts, not a schema/product/architecture freeze.

facts.fact: Runtime root is build-time LIFEOS_RUNTIME_ROOT and exactly three IPC commands are registered: capture_record, get_today, runtime_status.
Current controlled SQLite stores fixed synthetic captures/audit only; request validation is strict, AI is disabled, and unknown/direct capabilities are denied.
Runtime-root path, file type, SQLite schema, sidecar, candidate-residue, input, and atomic-publish checks fail closed.
Renderer calls only those IPC methods, uses a DOM/geometry attestation, and renders capture receipt/recent records from get_today.
The person-centered UI contains fixed in-memory Context, Memory, and Global AI examples, explicit no-silent-Context copy, and only demo persistence semantics.
Project is expressed as a Context type; Memory is a browser; Person/Page/Selection visibility and user confirmation are UI commitments, not implemented domain storage.
The build/root boundary and empty renderer permission surface are fail-closed; no plugin filesystem, shell, network, export, sync, vault, or model capability exists.

retain: The exact existing IPC names and the compatible request/response fields used by current UI.
Build-time task-local runtime-root derivation and all root/SQLite/sidecar/symlink fail-closed checks.
Offline, single-process, fixed synthetic-only boundary and a zero-plugin renderer capability surface.
Immutable capture identity, idempotency, audit receipt, restart visibility, and no-success-on-failure behavior.
Existing DOM/CSS shell and navigation only as a compatibility target; no P3-116 visual redesign.
adapt: Move capture/today behavior behind Application Services and repository ports; Rust/Tauri remains the host/security/IPC adapter, not the business-domain owner.
Extend get_today response compatibly with an optional context_recovery summary while preserving records, source, ai_status, and audit fields.
Replace fixed UI-only Context fixture behavior for one Project-backed synthetic Context with persisted, explicitly confirmed association evidence in the new task root.
Render Memory detail from provenance DTOs rather than fixture-only strings for the one vertical slice.
Render Global AI Context Inspector as preview-only, including visible Person/Page/Selection refs and removals; do not invoke a model.
defer: Non-Project Context types, Domain activation, full Me/Memory search, generic FTS, vector, external Source ingestion, and cross-domain reasoning.
ModelPort, AgentPort, actual AI output, health advice, notifications, scheduling, export, clear/delete/recovery, sync, network, Vault, and external files.
Frozen Schema/API decisions, generic Context table/entity, final IPC capability names, and technical architecture changes.
Any modification, rerun, or Evidence rewrite in P3-126/P3-127 historical directories.
compatibility_decision: A successor may copy only an explicitly allowlisted P3-126 source snapshot into a brand-new engineering root. It must not write P3-126 in place, inspect prohibited historical roots, or claim that P3-126 fixed fixtures already implement Person/Context/Memory semantics.
